## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- JOIN with omni metrics (BR omni_us variant)
FROM ads_seller_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live t
FULL OUTER JOIN omni_core_key_metrics_merge_daily oi
    ON t.shop_id <=> oi.shop_id
    AND t.grass_region = oi.grass_region
    AND t.grass_date = oi.grass_date
    AND t.entrance <=> oi.scene

-- JOIN with seller GMV
FULL OUTER JOIN dws_omni_item_shop_entrance_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live sg
    ON COALESCE(t.shop_id, oi.shop_id) <=> sg.shop_id
    AND COALESCE(t.grass_region, oi.grass_region) = sg.grass_region
    AND COALESCE(t.grass_date, oi.grass_date) = sg.grass_date
    AND COALESCE(t.entrance, oi.scene) <=> sg.entrance

-- JOIN with shop attributes
LEFT JOIN dim_omni_item_shop_attr_daily__reg_s0_live attr
    ON COALESCE(t.shop_id, oi.shop_id, sg.shop_id) = attr.shop_id
    AND COALESCE(t.grass_region, oi.grass_region, sg.grass_region) = attr.grass_region
    AND COALESCE(t.grass_date, oi.grass_date, sg.grass_date) = attr.grass_date
```

## Common Aggregations

**Standard shop-level aggregation from `ads_advertise_key_metrics_daily`:**
```sql
SELECT
    shop_id,
    entrance,
    max(shop_level1_global_be_category) as shop_level1_global_be_category,
    max(under_bidding_tier_1d) as under_bidding_tier_1d,
    max(budget_tier) as budget_tier,
    -- pcoc_tier: CASE-WHEN computed
    CASE
        WHEN sum(daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) IS NULL OR sum(broad_gmv_usd) IS NULL THEN 'null'
        WHEN nvl(sum(broad_gmv_usd), 0) = 0 THEN 'null'
        WHEN (sum(daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) / sum(broad_gmv_usd)) > 1.2 THEN 'overpcoc'
        WHEN (sum(daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) / sum(broad_gmv_usd)) > 0.8 THEN 'fulfillmentpcoc'
        ELSE 'underpcoc'
    END as pcoc_tier,
    -- Revenue/GMV: SUM
    sum(revenue_usd) as revenue_usd,
    sum(advv_usd) as advv_usd,
    sum(direct_gmv_usd) as direct_gmv_usd,
    sum(broad_gmv_usd) as broad_gmv_usd,
    sum(ads_imp) as ads_imp,
    sum(ads_clk) as ads_clk,
    -- Shop-level attributes: MAX
    max(valid_budget_campaign) as valid_budget_campaign,
    max(topup_usd) as topup_usd,
    max(daily_budget) as daily_budget,
    -- ad_tag: bitwise OR via MAX + bit operation
    (CASE WHEN MAX(MOD(FLOOR(coalesce(ad_tag, 0) / POWER(2, 34)), 2)) = 1 THEN POWER(2, 34) ELSE 0 END)
    + (CASE WHEN MAX(MOD(FLOOR(coalesce(ad_tag, 0) / POWER(2, 50)), 2)) = 1 THEN POWER(2, 50) ELSE 0 END)
    + (CASE WHEN MAX(MOD(FLOOR(coalesce(ad_tag, 0) / POWER(2, 61)), 2)) = 1 THEN POWER(2, 61) ELSE 0 END)
    AS ad_tag,
    grass_region
FROM ads_advertise_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
  AND grass_region in ('SG')
GROUP BY shop_id, entrance, grass_region, grass_date
```

**Snippet 3: BR omni_us FULL OUTER JOIN with omni metrics**
```sql
SELECT
    COALESCE(t.entrance, oi.scene, sg.entrance) as entrance,
    t.plan_bucket_id, t.pricing_type, t.ads_id, t.campaign_id, t.item_id,
    COALESCE(t.shop_id, oi.shop_id, sg.shop_id) as shop_id,
    t.revenue_usd, t.advv_usd, t.broad_gmv_usd,
    oi.ads_imp_cnt, oi.ads_clk_cnt, oi.ads_order_cnt, oi.ads_gmv_usd,
    oi.total_imp, oi.total_clk, oi.total_order, oi.total_gmv,
    oi.total_add_to_cart_cnt,
    COALESCE(attr.shop_gmv_tier, t.shop_gmv_tier) as shop_gmv_tier,
    attr.shop_name,
    sg.total_seller_gmv_usd
FROM ads_seller_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live t
FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, shop_id, scene,
        sum(ads_imp_cnt) as ads_imp_cnt,
        sum(total_gmv) as total_gmv,
        sum(total_atc) as total_add_to_cart_cnt
    FROM omni_core_key_metrics_merge_daily
    WHERE grass_region = 'BR' AND grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
    GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date, shop_id, scene
) oi ON t.shop_id <=> oi.shop_id AND ... AND t.entrance <=> oi.scene
FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, shop_id, entrance,
        sum(total_seller_gmv_usd) as total_seller_gmv_usd
    FROM dws_omni_item_shop_entrance_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = 'BR' AND grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
) sg ON COALESCE(t.shop_id, oi.shop_id) <=> sg.shop_id AND ...
LEFT JOIN dim_omni_item_shop_attr_daily__reg_s0_live attr
    ON COALESCE(t.shop_id, oi.shop_id, sg.shop_id) = attr.shop_id
```
